metadata.description: Iterative refinement of revenue breakdown by region with multiple explicit corrections

turns.content: Give me a revenue breakdown by region for the last 6 months of 1995.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show revenue by region for Jul-Dec 1995

turns.content: We should only look at customers who signed up before 1994 — they're our legacy cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to customers acquired before 1994

turns.content: When I say region, I mean the customer's region, not the supplier's region. Please always use customer region.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join CUSTOMER to NATION to REGION for customer's region

turns.content: Exclude the AMERICA region from all our analyses — there's a data quality issue there.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out AMERICA in all subsequent queries

turns.content: Apply the same filters we've established to show me top 10 customers by revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: legacy customers, customer region, exclude AMERICA

turns.content: Just to confirm — what filters are we currently applying to this analysis?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: For date filtering, always use O_ORDERDATE column.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use O_ORDERDATE

turns.content: Remember the legacy cohort filter we established? Apply that to show customer acquisition dates.

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the legacy cohort filter we established
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply pre-1994 customer filter

turns.content: Earlier we excluded AMERICA. What would the numbers look like if we included it?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show what AMERICA's contribution would be

turns.content: Keep AMERICA excluded. Show me the final revenue summary.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide summary with AMERICA excluded

turns.content: Apply all the corrections we've made to show me a final dashboard.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: legacy customers, customer region, exclude AMERICA, use O_ORDERDATE

turns.content: What was the revenue for EUROPE in November?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall Europe November revenue

turns.content: Show me the top 10 nations by revenue with all filters.
Thank you. We've established that legacy customers in Europe and Asia drive most revenue, with Europe showing growth while Asia is declining.

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Only look at customers who signed up before 1994
Always use customer region, not supplier region
Exclude AMERICA region from all analyses
